label: Dolly Zoom (Vertigo Shot)
description: Animation · 4 s · 1920×1080 (paysage). Camera tracks toward or away from the subject while the field of view changes the opposite way, so the subject holds its frame size while the background collapses behind it or rushes in. Focal length is solved from dolly distance every frame against d * tan(FOV/2) = const, not keyframed beside it. Requires depth: the subject sits on the z = 0 plane and the content behind it must be layered or genuinely 3D (translateZ at two or more distinct depths) -- a flat element gains nothing from this move.

options.help: Wobbled rounded rectangle draws on — across the authored stroke matrix (plain/soft/sharp/spray) — or drops in and lands with a volume-true contact squash and bouncy spring recovery, with a handwritten label above or centered; boils

options.label: Scribble Callout Circle
options.help: Wobbled ellipse draws around a target with optional scribble fill and curved connector; the handwritten label pops in WITH momentum and the drawn shapes absorb the arrival with a volume-preserving contact squash; outline and connector take the family stroke matrix (plain/soft/sharp/spray); boils

options.label: Squiggle Marks
options.help: Hand-drawn squiggle underline, double-pass strikethrough, and bracket marks that draw on

options.label: Icon Morph Beat
options.help: An icon morphs between authored state silhouettes, shifts to an accent color, and marks completion with one restrained pulse.

options.label: Icon Swap
options.help: A scale-and-blur icon swap primitive for toolbar and action state changes

options.label: Ink Bleed Reveal
options.help: Liquid ink blooms through paper under a gooey blur-plus-threshold filter, merges, then contracts as a crisp slotted mark resolves beneath it, with static seeded paper grain riding the result.

options.label: Inline Highlight
options.help: A clean marker-style inline highlight that animates behind text using a CSS scale variable

options.label: Input Feedback
options.help: A transitions.dev-inspired input feedback primitive with shake, clear affordance, and success state

options.label: Iris Reveal
options.help: A circle clip-path opens from an authored origin revealing state B over state A in one confident pass, then holds on B. Classic register dims and desaturates the before state so the after state lands in full color; a thin accent rim rides the iris edge. Callers fill the named before/after slot panels; token-styled defaults render when a slot is left empty.

options.label: Keyframe Scrub Stack
options.help: A keyframe-sequenced stack of cards with offset timing and easing presets.

options.label: Kinetic Center Build
options.help: Words enter from the right and push the growing phrase left until the final line locks centered.

options.label: Kinetic Type Swap
options.help: A held sentence keeps its fixed text in place while one widest-word masked slot rolls through alternatives and settles on the final option.

options.label: Light Sweep Pass
options.help: A traveling key light re-shades a slotted scene: a soft diagonal gradient band crosses the frame once while every per-element highlight and shadow shifts in lockstep (all driven by one --light-x property), then the light settles into a resting key. Quiet, expensive-feeling; the scene itself never moves. Callers fill the named scene slot; a token hero-and-cards default renders when it is left empty.

options.label: Line-by-Line Slide
options.help: Each line enters from the left with staggered slide and exits to the right.

options.label: Line Swap
options.help: A masked full-line beat replacement: line A holds center then exits up through an overflow-hidden mask as line B enters bottom-up on the same beat, with an optional accent underline drawing beneath one word of line B.

options.label: Locked Nucleus Orbit
options.help: A fixed center nucleus anchors deterministic satellite orbits that settle into a composed lockup.

options.label: Logo Brand Close
options.help: A display-scale wordmark cascades letter by letter into a centered lockup, the accent brand period lands last, an optional tagline and wide-tracked mono URL settle beneath, and the finished identity holds dead still to the end of the film.

options.label: Logo Sting
options.help: A wordmark slams into its final scale, fires one accent ring and one white impact frame, then holds completely still.

options.label: Logo Wall
options.help: A trusted-by wall of placeholder lettermark logos that fades and scales into place with a deterministic per-cell stagger.

options.label: Magnetic Cursor
options.help: A soft dot pointer glides across an editor toolbar, is pulled into each button and morphs into its rounded hover plate while the icon leans toward it, presses one, and leaves as a dot.

options.label: Marker Checklist Card
options.help: A hand-lettered paper card: marker headline with an underline and a drawn ellipse around one word, then three checklist rows whose checks draw themselves on - typewriter labels, marker values. The paper-and-marker sibling of mk-specs-list's clean professional rows

options.label: Marker Highlight
options.help: Display text settles in, then one hand-drawn marker stroke (highlight, circle, underline, or scribble) draws over the emphasized word on cue.

options.label: Match Cut
options.help: A circle accelerates into a hard single-frame scene swap, matches the incoming circle exactly, and continues into a smaller resting pose.

options.label: Matrix Decode
options.help: Random scramble resolves left-to-right into the target text.

options.label: Menu Morph
options.help: A transitions.dev-inspired hamburger and plus-menu morph primitive for compact action menus

options.label: Mesh Gradient Background
options.help: A render-safe mesh gradient using animated radial layers.

options.label: Micro Transitions
options.help: A transitions.dev-inspired pack of badge, dropdown, modal, tabs, tooltip, and success-check micro transitions

options.label: Background Emphasis Type
options.help: Oversized low-contrast background word drifting slowly behind the subject — typography as texture

options.label: Hairline Arc Gauge
options.help: Thin circular gauge that draws on while its percentage counts up; one helper call drives both

options.label: Modal Morph
options.help: A small card expands into a full panel, shared-element style: both layouts measured once at mount, the container morphs by transform only (never width/height tweens) while keyed children counter-scale and re-flow onto their own measured targets as pure functions of time.

options.label: Morph Swap
options.help: Two slotted siblings stacked at one shared center: A holds, then condenses or reshapes into B on a shared 50% 50% transform origin. Condense shrink-fades A exactly as B scales up; reshape morphs the silhouette on scaleX/scaleY, never width or height tweens. Token card defaults render when a slot is left empty.

options.label: Morph Text
options.help: Gooey text morph — cycles through an editable word list using SVG threshold + GSAP-driven blur for a fluid, satisfying transition effect

options.label: Motion Blur
options.help: After Effects-style motion blur — integrates each element over a shutter window (shutter angle, phase, samples per frame) by sampling the GSAP timeline at sub-frame times and averaging equal-weight additive copies of the element along its real trajectory, so translation, scale, rotation, 3D rotation and skew all drive the smear

options.label: Multi Device Splay
options.help: Phone, tablet, and desktop product mockups fan from a centered stack into a proud splayed arrangement with a subtle idle float.

options.label: Multiplayer Cursors
options.help: Labeled collaborator cursors with token-derived colors and soft glows drift from spread positions into a shared center zone, proving live multiplayer presence.

options.label: Native Notification Pop
options.help: One system-faithful notification banner (iOS or macOS) drops in over any scene on an accurate interruptible spring: fast arrival, soft overshoot, settled mass, backdrop blur, app dot, title, one body line. Holds; tucks away only via exit.

options.label: Notes Typing
options.help: The notes-app confession as a mountable scene: a bold title, then body lines typed character by character on the measured human keystroke rhythm, the caret riding every landed character and jumping down at each paragraph. For a bare prompt line use typed-prompt; for an even mechanical reveal use typewriter

options.label: Notification Pileup
options.help: Mobile notification cards arrive faster and faster, each new alert pushing the existing stack downward into a dense, anxious tower.

options.label: Notification Stack
options.help: 1 to 5 token notification cards slide-settle into a vertical stack on cues, newest on top; one card grows slightly and brightens as the focus while the rest dim by position.

options.label: Number Pop In
options.help: A transitions.dev-inspired digit pop-in with blur, lift, and staggered value reveal

options.label: Number Wheel
options.help: A rolling digit counter primitive for metrics, prices, counts, and scoreboards

options.label: Offset Path Traveler
options.help: A slotted traveler follows an authored path with tangent rotation, curved entry, and curved exit.

options.label: Onboarding Stepper Flow
options.help: A composed onboarding flow with milestone rail, active step card, and next-action button

options.label: Ordered Dither Pass
options.help: Bayer-matrix ordered dithering quantizes a slotted scene (rasterized once at mount): the image emerges from pure 2-tone noise to clean, or dissolves the reverse. Stateless per frame, never error diffusion.

options.label: Outline Draw
options.help: A rounded outline that proves a callout by drawing clockwise as a hollow conic-gradient border with a clean closure.

options.label: Oversized Cursor
options.help: The look-here pointer for a video: the macOS arrow at 3.5x its normal size lands its tip on one control, clicks it on, settles just below it so the result stays in view, then exits off-screen

options.label: Overwhelm Surround
options.help: Tasks, tabs, pings, and notification bubbles accelerate inward around a calm central subject, turning overload into visible spatial pressure.

options.label: Page Slide
options.help: A transitions.dev-inspired page slide primitive with outgoing and incoming panels

options.label: Pan Stations
options.help: A lateral camera move across a continuous row of labeled feature stations, with a steady dwell at each stop before the next pan.

options.label: Panel Reveal
options.help: A panel reveal primitive with height expansion and content fade

options.label: Paper Collage Reveal
options.help: A scrapbook patchwork of torn paper scraps, each with its own texture and tilt, flutters away in a staggered scatter to reveal the content underneath.

options.label: Parallax Device Dive
options.help: A canonical phone rises into view before the camera pushes through its screen and layered app UI expands to fill the frame.

options.label: Parallax Unzoom
options.help: Reveal transition — focus card scales down from full frame as siblings parallax in to form a grid (reverse of parallax-zoom)

options.label: Parallax Zoom
options.help: Center card scales up to fill the frame while siblings parallax outward — inspired by the eBay Playbook hero transition

options.label: Particle Image Reveal
options.help: A seeded deterministic particle field converges and settles while a slotted image reveals beneath it, the trail thinning until the image holds clean.

options.label: Particle Text Dissolve
options.help: Text assembles from a seeded particle cloud (or dissolves into it): per-particle targets sampled once from the rendered text bitmap at mount, table-driven particles, zero per-particle tweens, one onUpdate painter.

options.label: Pendulum Swing
options.help: Content hangs from a fixed pivot and swings into rest with gravity-damped oscillation, like a hanging sign settling on its hook.

options.label: Per-Word Crossfade
options.help: Words gently fade into place with a short vertical drift for calm keynote rhythm.

options.label: Per Word Rise
options.help: Words or characters rise into place in a controlled blur-to-sharp cascade, settle softly on landing, and hold still until the cut (optional fade or up exit).

options.label: Perspective Marquee
options.help: A 3D tilted marquee with depth feel as items roll toward the horizon.

options.label: Physical Exit
options.help: A card exits with physical momentum in toss, drop, or slide mode, carrying acceleration and rotation through the final offscreen pose without fading.

options.label: Press Ripple
options.help: A cursor decel-arrives from off-stage, lands slightly off-center on a caller-positioned target, compresses with it in lockstep, releases with two small click rings while the label swaps to a check, then exits off-stage while the confirmed state holds.

options.label: Pull Back Reveal
options.help: A tight stat detail holds, then one decelerating camera pull-back reveals the headline and supporting cards that recontextualize it.

options.label: Pull to Refresh
options.help: A mobile list pulls through nonlinear rubber-band resistance, arms at a threshold, commits to a bounded loading indicator, then snaps exactly back to rest.

options.label: Push In
options.help: A centered headline gains focus through one slow, continuous camera push and a gentle fade out.

options.label: Radial Surround
options.help: Labeled hairline chips assemble around a centered subject on an elliptical ring, then optionally converge inward with a subtle edge dim. The center never moves: surrounded, not zoomed.

options.label: RGB Glitch Text
options.help: RGB-offset text copies jitter briefly for a controlled glitch window.

options.label: Rubber Band Bumper
options.help: An outgoing panel pulls against increasing resistance, holds at tension, then snaps past an edge with overshoot as the incoming panel settles behind it.

options.label: Scan Band
options.help: A diagonal distortion band sweeps once across a clean wordmark, revealing clipped red and cyan offsets only inside the moving band.

options.label: Scramble Reveal
options.help: A deterministic hacker-style text reveal that cycles fixed glyph rows and locks the target string from left to right.

options.label: Screen Flow Carousel
options.help: Two to five app screens ride a horizontal rail: one primary at center, neighbors receded, advancing on cues with a velocity-matched throw and a smooth long-tail catch while a mono caption swaps with each advance. Screens are slots with token skeleton defaults.

options.label: Scroll Camera Story
options.help: A compressed forced-scroll cinematic pass: a tall scene of slotted sections travels past the camera top to bottom, depth layers parallax at different rates, each section rises as the camera reaches it, and the pass decelerates into a held final section.

options.label: Scroll Feed
options.help: A loop-friendly column of varied skeleton post cards scrolls upward with subtle motion trails and an agitated pace.

options.label: Segmentation Flood
options.help: Machine-vision read of a slotted subject: translucent accent segmentation masks flood on in quantized scanline steps, each region gets a thin bracket and mono label chip, a deterministic 2-frame HUD flicker rides the pass, then the labeled read settles clean.

options.label: Separator
options.help: A one-pixel structural separator with horizontal and vertical variants plus a seek-safe progress reveal

options.label: Settings Toggle Flow
options.help: A composed settings flow with preference rows, toggle switches, and active-state feedback

options.label: Shared Axis Y
options.help: Per-word vertical shared-axis transition for sharp editorial swaps.

options.label: Shared Axis Z
options.help: Scale-based shared-axis transition for focus shifts and context depth.

options.label: Sheet Spring-Up
options.help: A bottom sheet rushes up from below the frame on a real spring sampled frame by frame from reference footage, overshooting its resting place and settling back without an approximated ease

options.label: Shimmer Sweep
options.help: Animated light sweep across text or elements using a CSS gradient mask — ideal for AI accents and premium reveals

options.label: Shutter Slam
options.help: One word thrown through six single-property beats under integrated shutter blur — two translate slams, a scale punch, then a full turn about each axis — on the measured easing of the After Effects export the shutter model was fitted to

options.label: Signup Flow
options.help: A composed signup flow with social action, email field, password field, and submit button

options.label: Skeleton Reveal
options.help: A skeleton loader transition that pulses, then cross-fades into content

options.label: Slit Scan Reveal
options.help: The frame's rows sample an authored subject at offset times: a canvas painter draws row slices of one pure position function evaluated at t minus offset(row), smearing arrival through time until the offsets collapse to zero and the mark holds coherent.

options.label: Slot Machine Roll
options.help: A vertical reel scrolls characters from one value to another.

options.label: Social Proof Card
options.help: The app-store close as one mountable scene: wordmark, five stars, a proof line, three feature icons and a CTA capsule build in a quiet stagger and hold - measured from reference ad footage. For an animated star sweep use star-rating-fill; for a quote card use testimonial-proof-card; for a bare lockup use cta-lockup

options.label: Soft Blob Touch
options.help: A granular soft blob idles with slow internal drift; a scripted touch dot decel-arrives, the blob deforms toward it with an attraction bulge, then recovers with a velocity-preserving spring. No hard edges anywhere.

options.label: Soft Blur In
options.help: A soft opacity, blur, and lift reveal for headlines, captions, and product UI callouts

options.label: Split Tilt Cards
options.help: Two equal-weight cards arrive from opposite wings with mirrored rotateY book-open tilts under one shared perspective, pill badges spring-pop at each inner edge, and the pair holds with a barely-there phase-opposed idle float. Card bodies are content slots with token skeleton defaults.

options.label: Spotlight Card
options.help: A card with a scripted cursor spotlight and lit border.

options.label: Spring Pop
options.help: A badge pops in from a visible near-rest scale, overshoots full size once, and settles cleanly.

options.label: Spring Stack Shuffle
options.help: A stack of 3 to 5 slotted cards reshuffles on cues: the back card throws over the top and lands at the front with real mass, the rest compress and resettle; cues that land mid-flight redirect the moving cards with velocity preserved.

options.label: Stagger Cascade
options.help: A responsive grid of tile cards that fades and travels into place with an evenly spaced per-item GSAP stagger. The ordered cascade is the only visual mechanic.

options.label: Stagger Lattice
options.help: A staggered grid reveal inspired by Anime.js v4 stagger utilities, implemented with GSAP for HyperFrames.

options.label: Staggered Fade Up
options.help: Words fade in and slide up one after another with configurable delay.

options.label: Star Rating Fill
options.help: A token-driven star row whose colored layer sweeps to a rating, preserves the fractional final star, and can count the value in sync.

options.label: State Chip Rail
options.help: A rail of mono status chips advances a seek-safe data-state snap machine on a cue schedule: active chip ink on surface, done chips dim, pending chips hollow, optional badges pop beside one state.

options.label: Sticky Mock Swap
options.help: A pinned product mock cross-fades through accent-tinted feature states while matching captions rise, hold, and exit beside it.

options.label: Stitched Text Draw
options.help: Text drawn as thread stitches: a single-stroke display alphabet draws via attribute-driven dashoffset with stitch-tuned dash patterns, seeded angle jitter, needle-hole dots, a leading needle, and a thread-tail overshoot per letter.

options.label: Stop Motion Cadence
options.help: The stepped-time law as a demo primitive: one driver quantizes timeline time to floor(t * fps) / fps and feeds ALL motion; four token paper-cut shapes throw-and-land with squash on hits, 2-frame boil jitter seeded per step, and sparkle accents living exactly 2 to 3 frames.

options.label: Store Badge Lockup
options.help: Settles a short headline above equal-size App Store and Google Play badges as a token-driven mobile end-card call to action.

options.label: Streaming Text
options.help: Words arrive the way an AI answer streams - in uneven bursts on a measured token rhythm, each word landing grey and inking to full colour - rather than the even tick of a typewriter

options.label: Strikethrough Replace
options.help: Draw a strike line across old text, then reveal the replacement.

options.label: Success Check
options.help: A success check primitive with ring pop, path draw, and subtle rotate blur

options.label: SVG Line Draw Loader
options.help: An Anime.js-style path drawing loader implemented as a seekable GSAP stroke timeline.

options.label: SVG Mask Reveal
options.help: A soft token-colored sweep reveals media only through an editable SVG wordmark mask.

options.label: SVG Stroke Trace
options.help: An authored SVG path draws from its measured length, holds with subtle drift, and optionally fills when the path is closed.

options.label: Swipe Rail
options.help: A contact circle leads a horizontal card rail through a fast drag, momentum carry, and settled snap to the next card.

options.label: Tabs Slide Indicator
options.help: A pill indicator transition that slides between active tabs

options.label: Telemetry HUD
options.help: Quiet mono debug-HUD readouts frame a slotted subject: corner brackets draw on, label:value lines tick their values on cues, one readout emphasized in accent. The subject never moves; the HUD breathes zero.

options.label: Terminal Simulator
options.help: A terminal window types commands and streams log output.

options.label: Testimonial Card
options.help: Reveals a customer quote at reading pace, then settles its avatar, author name, and handle beneath as a clean proof beat.

options.label: Testimonial Proof Card
options.help: A quote card whose testimonial reveals per-line through a soft mask, with an avatar disc (initials default, image slot), mono name and role, an optional company text mark, and one emphasis substring underlined in accent ink after the quote lands.

options.label: Text Match Cut
options.help: One line of text becomes another mid-move: both ride a single 85 % easy-ease curve and hard-swap at the speed peak, as scale, tracking, or a same-direction slide.

options.label: Text Shimmer
options.help: A static headline receives one clean specular gradient sweep through its glyphs, then returns to its ordinary text color.

options.label: Text Stagger
options.help: A transitions.dev-inspired text stagger primitive with enter, shimmer, and exit-ready words

options.label: Text State Swap
options.help: A text state swap primitive with outgoing blur and incoming lift

options.label: Texture Mask Text
options.help: CSS luminance masks that cut holes through letterforms - 66 pre-built texture masks from ambientCG PBR color maps

options.label: Three Orbiting Cards
options.help: A Three.js-powered orbit scene driven by a paused GSAP timeline for deterministic renders.

options.label: Ticker Takeover
options.help: A mono ticker rolls through options, locks on a final word with an accent flash, and promotes it into a full-frame headline.

options.label: Tilt Card
options.help: A transitions.dev-inspired tilt card primitive with depth layers and hover-style parallax

options.label: Titlecard Calm
options.help: A restrained title card where a mono kicker and generous grotesque headline fade upward, drift almost imperceptibly, and exit cleanly.

options.label: Titlecard Lockup
options.help: The calm breather titlecard: an optional mono kicker fades up, the wordmark settles dead-center with one restrained move, a hairline rule draws left to right, a mono label fades beneath, and the lockup holds truly still.

options.label: Toggle Flip
options.help: An oversized UI toggle switch that flips with real physicality: thumb overshoot, track color crossfade, and a soft press-compress before release. The reference prop of the ui-props family.

options.label: Top-Down Letters
options.help: Letters descend from above in a pronounced staircase with zero blur.

options.label: Torn Paper Rip
options.help: A fibrous paper tear runs across the frame: the torn sheet shows its white paper core along the edge and lifts away on a soft shadow, leaving the next scene standing.

options.label: Touch Indicator
options.help: A translucent contact-circle gesture actor for mobile UI scenes: it touches the glass on the frame the host target responds, then lifts. Tap or swipe, picked by variable.

options.label: Tracing Beam
options.help: A glowing dash follows one SVG path through three UI elements, lifting and brightening each element in sequence.

options.label: Tracking In
options.help: A precise letter-spacing reveal for premium headings and interface labels

options.label: Trust Strip
options.help: A monochrome trust row of wide-tracked mono wordmarks that fade in with an opacity-only left-to-right stagger, then hold dead still.

options.label: Type Match Cut
options.help: A headline splits vertically around an incoming panel, which grows from the negative space and takes the frame as the words exit through opposite edges.

options.label: Typed Prompt
options.help: A prompt line types itself in chunked human cadence behind a deterministic blinking caret, with optional backspace-and-retype correction of the final word.

options.label: Typewriter
options.help: Character-by-character text reveal with a deterministic blinking cursor.

options.label: Typing Indicator
options.help: The three-dot chat bubble that says someone is writing: it pops in at the thread's edge exactly as messaging apps do, holds while the reply is coming, and vanishes when the message lands

options.label: UI Focus Zoom
options.help: A full app surface establishes with one settle, then the camera zooms and pans to an anchored region on its cue and holds the zoomed state, with an optional soft focus halo at the anchor. The surface is a slot with a token-styled skeleton default.

options.label: Variable Axis Type
options.help: A locked one-line headline whose weight or width axis morphs into a decisive emphasis beat.

options.label: Variable Font Flex
options.help: A word lands while its variable-font weight and width axes flex from hairline-condensed to black-wide with per-character stagger; font-size eases inversely so the letterforms gain mass while the box holds.

options.label: Vector Editor Rig
options.help: A dark design-tool app chrome with a live vector pen path, sequential anchor points, bezier handles, a selection frame, and theme-driven blue accents.

options.label: Velocity Throw Snap
options.help: A five-shot rail whips past on a fast decaying curve, then overshoots and snaps the selected hero shot exactly to center.

options.label: Vignette
options.help: Cinematic radial vignette overlay using a pure-CSS gradient — darkens the edges to pull focus toward the center

options.label: Vox Annotate
options.help: The Vox-style annotate gesture: a keyword in a held sentence gets a hand-drawn marker while a thin connector draws up to a mono callout label, all as one choreographed beat on the cue.

options.label: Whip Pan Cut
options.help: A full-frame whip pan: scene A whips off laterally with capped directional motion blur while scene B enters in the same direction at matched velocity, on a speed-ramp profile with a decelerating catch. Both scenes ride one strip, so seam velocity is exact by construction. Callers fill the named before/after slot panels; token-styled defaults render when a slot is left empty.

options.label: Whiteboard Ink
options.help: A whiteboard sketch draws one measured stroke at a time while a pen nib follows the active tip. Preset sketches (bulb, flow, rocket) or your own multi-stroke SVG paths via the strokes slot; a path marked data-ink=accent rides the accent token.

options.label: Wordmark Tiles
options.help: A wordmark resolves from deterministic color noise into correctly cropped glyph tiles through a spatially modulated GSAP wave.

options.label: X Follow Card
options.help: A social follow card with avatar, handle, and follower motion.

options.label: Zoom Through Transition
options.help: A transition that zooms through a focal card into the next scene.
